description: Describes moments that participants reported no possible association between gender and food.

description: Describes moments that participants rejected or were unsure of the idea of a gender influence, but went on to discuss highly gendered food contexts (e.g. barbecuing, portion sizes, who does the cooking) seemingly without awareness, or recognition of the gendered nature of these comments.
